item.title: [paper] Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
item.description: QUAN is a quaternion-based deep learning framework that approximates quaternion convolution with real-valued operations to achieve rotation-equivariant image classification and object detection with improved efficiency.

item.title: [paper] Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
item.description: Lipi-Ghor is a large-scale weakly supervised Bengali speech corpus with speaker-diarized long-form annotations and a gold evaluation split for benchmarking ASR models.

item.title: [paper] Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
item.description: Wiener-informed Decoding accelerates pixel-space velocity model training and improves image generation by integrating statistical predictions into decoder computation without altering native blocks.

item.title: [paper] What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
item.description: Reinforcement learning improves pass@1 mainly by finishing answers faster and increasing reliability rather than acquiring new problem-solving knowledge, with minimal reach gains under fixed token budgets.

item.title: [paper] How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
item.description: Fin-SD improves local multi-step financial reasoning by using self-generated error critiques and truncated correct prefixes for on-policy distillation without external teachers.

item.title: [repo] Speedrunlab/reverse-engineer-anything-self-learning-loop
item.description: Agent skill that examines an authorized product, builds a custom version, and iteratively tests it against a written parity checklist until all requirements pass.

item.description: Machine learning-enhanced optical modeling of polarized resonant soft X-ray scattering enables quantitative, depth-resolved analysis of molecular orientation and packing at buried interfaces.

item.description: T-DIG is a text-conditioned diversity framework that uses an LLM policy with reinforcement learning to generate axis-specific image variations via frozen generators, enabling user-directed exploration without model retraining.

item.title: [model] LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B
item.description: Vision-language model from LiquidAI. 1.6k downloads and 129 likes so far.

item.description: AlphaBet uses agentic reinforcement learning to train a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report forecast probabilities across multiple dates, reducing Brier scores by improving both evidence acquisition and probability reporting.

item.title: [news] Quoting Terk Terkowitz
item.description: If your work does not benefit from current AI tooling, that is a finding, not a failing. Document why, share it with your community of peers, bring it to your manager, and work to find solutions.

item.title: [paper] Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
item.description: EvidenceConnect synthesizes training data to strengthen visual evidence connection, improving spatial perception and multimodal reasoning across diverse tasks.

item.title: [paper] RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
item.description: RynnWorld-Latent learns cross-embodiment world dynamics via 3D-grounded latent actions, enabling joint pretraining on diverse video sources and synthetic data generation for improved robot policy performance.

item.title: [paper] Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
item.description: Multiscale Policy Optimization improves long-horizon agent training by aligning credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale.

item.title: [paper] The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
item.description: Pre-training corpora leave a lexical imprint on zero-shot accuracy that is consistently tracked by word-level unigram cross-entropy across benchmarks, document selection, and prompt routing.

item.title: [repo] siri2moon/moonreel
item.description: MoonReel is an open-source Meta Muse video generator that automates muse.ai to turn an idea into a scripted, subtitled short video for social media platforms.

item.title: [paper] h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
item.description: A simple agentic loop with efficient Lean feedback achieves state-of-the-art formal theorem proving without structured workflows, showing that execution interfaces matter more than complex orchestration.

item.title: [repo] DavidDingXu/hello-llm
item.description: Language model introductory course featuring an interactive small model, 20 illustrated lessons, 23 videos, and browser-based training experiments.

item.title: [repo] vasikmansuri/universal-calling-agent-toolkit
item.description: Universal-calling-agent-toolkit offers provider-neutral telephony adapters, an audio pipeline, and email capture to add reliable voice capabilities to existing AI calling agents.

item.title: [model] openbmb/MiniCPM-OCR-1.0
item.description: Vision-language model from openbmb. 791 downloads and 202 likes so far.

item.description: Looped transformers trained with full backpropagation through time outperform truncated alternatives under matched compute, with scaling laws identifying two loops as optimal when model size is adjustable.

item.title: [repo] aa1143/NamiGPT

item.title: [paper] Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
item.description: Hexels uses planar hexagonal surface elements to improve 3D scene reconstruction quality and rendering efficiency while lowering memory demands.

item.title: [paper] ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
item.description: ThinkWorld improves robotic generalization by representing actions as dynamics chains and using world imagination to learn from unlabeled human videos.

item.title: [paper] Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
item.description: Factorized Vector Quantization improves discrete visual token quality by using parallel codebooks on complementary feature views, enabling discrete representations to match continuous ones in multimodal understanding.

item.title: [paper] When Should We Intervene at Test Time?
item.description: Portal is a test-time control method that decides when to apply model interventions, select inputs for labeling, and stop querying to prevent accuracy losses.

item.title: [paper] Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
item.description: Heads of Security uses learned attention gates to enforce instruction-data separation, protecting large language models from prompt injection attacks.

item.title: [paper] Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
item.description: Holonomy attention is a relational graph framework that uses Wilson loops for equivariant edge updates and relation inference without training.

item.title: [paper] KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
item.description: KPPax is a preprocessor that converts atmospheric chemical mechanisms into differentiable, vectorizable JAX code for machine learning applications.

item.title: [paper] Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well
item.description: Simulation-trained robotic policies and a safety filter enable multi-fingered hands to achieve dexterous in-hand object pose reaching and minimize drops.

item.title: [paper] GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
item.description: GEPA-Curator is a prompt optimization framework that filters out unreliable agent tasks and retrieves successful past trajectories to improve multi-turn agent performance.

item.title: [paper] Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
item.description: LongChang evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously discover altered physical laws through simulated experimentation, finding that only one model achieved limited success.

item.title: [paper] Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
item.description: SynthAPI is a synthetic environment generation pipeline that produces data to derive scaling laws for training performant large language model tool-use agents.

item.title: [paper] MuonGS: Pretraining LLMs with Relaxed Weight-Norm Control
item.description: MuonGS is an optimizer that uses Gram-Schmidt projection to remove radial components of weight updates, guaranteeing sustained effective learning rate accumulation during pretraining.

item.title: [paper] Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
item.description: MERLIN is a multi-state linear attention routing method that tracks first and second key moments to improve query-segment aggregation for long-context language modeling.

item.title: [paper] Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
item.description: Metacognitive decoding is a lightweight controller for diffusion language agents that guides generation length and token finalization to reduce inference computation costs.

item.title: [paper] Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Cross-View Temporal Object Correspondence
item.description: XTrack is a unified framework that repurposes pretrained video diffusion transformers with specialized attention and cropping strategies to track object identity across views and time.

item.title: [paper] What Improves During Pretraining? Tracking Knowledge Acquisition with Point-in-Time Models
item.description: This research paper proposes a temporal variability score to track how language models acquire knowledge of varying consistency across different years of pretraining web text.

item.title: [paper] Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
item.description: This learning paradigm combines autoregressive pretraining for semantic knowledge acquisition with diffusion post-training for high-fidelity visual rendering in text-to-image models.

item.title: [paper] Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
item.description: When compressing multi-agent discussions for final decisions, memory selection by rarity or relevance both fail due to decoy inclusion and social-proof bias, and even full transcripts reduce accuracy compared to no notes.

item.title: [paper] Perceiving and Predicting Dynamic Sports: Spatiotemporal Intelligence in Vision Models for Egocentric Tennis Video
item.description: This study introduces an annotated egocentric tennis dataset and evaluates vision models on spatiotemporal prediction tasks such as player localization and stroke anticipation.

item.title: [paper] VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
item.description: VideoLVR is a multimodal framework that constructs latent visual evidence from local video regions to support intermediate reasoning steps and prevent visual forgetting.

item.title: [paper] Agentic Distributional Regression: Conditional Density Estimation through Agent-Written Programs
item.description: Agentic distributional regression is a method that uses language-model agents to write short programs for estimating conditional probability densities from data.

item.title: [paper] EnvSched: Environment-Aware Scheduling for Rollout-Efficient Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description: EnvSched is an online environment-aware scheduler that improves rollout efficiency in agent reinforcement learning by predicting reward variance and managing task diversity.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Answer Changes: Matched Same-Class Controls for Local Audio Evidence
item.description: A matched same-class evaluation protocol tests how audio-language models respond to local sound-event edits while preserving the correct answer class.

item.title: [paper] MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
item.description: MoI-Bench is a mobile-focused benchmark comprising 64 subtasks and a two-dimensional quality-deployability map to evaluate image generation and editing models on devices.

item.title: [paper] GAS-PFN: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Traffic Forecasting
item.description: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Network is a zero-shot traffic forecasting model that incorporates road topology and separate temporal and spatial processing to predict traffic dynamics without parameter updates.

item.title: [paper] Understanding the limits of latent world models
item.description: Latent rollout consistency is a proposed metric that evaluates whether learned latent world models accurately reflect the true underlying transition dynamics of an environment.

item.title: [paper] Timestral
item.description: Timestral is a family of time series foundation models that achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting through decoupled horizon forecasting, native future covariate support, and synthetic pretraining followed by mixed post-training.

item.title: [paper] REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
item.description: REGER is a generative recommendation framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item semantic and collaborative relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation.

item.title: [paper] Zero-Shot Multimodal Event Spotting in Soccer Broadcasts
item.description: A zero-shot multimodal framework detects, classifies, and temporally localizes events in soccer broadcasts using visual storyboards and commentary transcripts without task-specific training.

item.title: [paper] Spectral Braids: A Topological Descriptor for Dynamic Directed Networks
item.description: Spectral braids is a topological descriptor methodology that tracks complex eigenvalues of dynamic directed networks over time to produce fixed-size feature vectors for network classification.

item.title: [paper] As the Story Unfolds: Watching a Film and Identifying Characters as a Human Does
item.description: A novel video-and-dialogue model and progressive framework enable movies to be understood online by identifying and naming characters incrementally using cinematic cues from the film itself.

item.title: [paper] The Noise Plane: A Diffusion Bridge Across Exponent and Dispersion
item.description: The p-Bridge framework proposes a unified measurement-indexed diffusion model for Tweedie noise, improving cross-exponent robustness in image and signal denoising tasks.

item.title: [paper] TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
item.description: TeamGym is an evaluation and training environment designed to study and improve how AI agents share and integrate distributed information for team decision-making.

item.title: [paper] LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
item.description: LCM-Promo is a task-specific Large Commerce Model that predicts user intent and promotion response from transactional data to optimize promotion allocation and conversion.

item.title: [paper] Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents
item.description: Gym-Anything-RT is an environment scaling platform with 100 visual minigames for evaluating and testing the real-time interaction capabilities of vision-language AI agents.

item.title: [paper] ReferStream: Interactive Subject Injection for Streaming Video Generation
item.description: ReferStream is a training-free video generation framework that injects new visual references into streaming video while preserving established subjects and scene consistency.

item.title: [paper] Pneuma: A Large-Scale Real-World Time Series Benchmark for Commercial Aircraft Predictive Maintenance
item.description: Pneuma is a large-scale real-time time series benchmark using commercial aircraft sensor data to evaluate multivariate forecasting, fault classification, and anomaly detection.

item.title: [paper] When uncertainty quantification fails: structural vulnerabilities and corrections for selective prediction under clinical class imbalance
item.description: This framework combines conditional calibration risk with threshold-aware metrics to correct uncertainty quantification vulnerabilities in selective prediction under severe clinical class imbalance.

item.title: [paper] Collective Dynamics of Self-Reinforcement: How Cross-Task Coupling Drives Policy Collapse in Unsupervised RLVR
item.description: This study analyzes how cross-task coupling and self-reinforcement drive policy collapse in unsupervised reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards when training on large datasets.

item.title: [paper] Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
item.description: Constraint-Referenced Strategy projects end-effector twists onto object joint axes to evaluate articulated object manipulation policies beyond simple binary success rates.

item.title: [paper] When, Where, and What to Correct: Human-Guided Adaptive Residual Correction for Robot Policies
item.description: Adaptive Residual Correction is a post-training module that uses sparse human corrections and reinforcement learning to improve the precision of frozen robot imitation policies.

item.title: [paper] GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
item.description: Satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model uses satellite images alongside street-level inputs to generate seamless and realistic novel views for outdoor scenes without 3D scene reconstruction.

item.title: [paper] Which Hand Was Late? Diagnosis for Robot Failure Recovery in Bimanual Tool Use
item.description: Robot manipulation failure diagnosable through vision-language models reveals how different sensing channels and prompt wording affect the identification of bimanual tool-use errors.

item.title: [paper] GTFormer: A Syntax-Free Graph Network Alternative to Transformers for 8192$\times$ Length Extrapolation in Linear Time
item.description: GTFormer is a syntax-free hierarchical graph neural network that replaces flat self-attention for long-context sequence modeling, enabling zero-shot length extrapolation in linear time and memory.

item.title: [paper] The Structure Gap: When More Data Cannot Replace Structured Reasoning
item.description: Structure gap framework demonstrates that finite datasets leave residual uncertainty that known structural information resolves by construction, which data-driven learners cannot fully replace.

item.title: [paper] Orthogonal and Parametrized Multi-Attribute Steering of LLMs
item.description: Orthogonalized and parameterized activation steering method modifies large language model behavior by setting trait strengths at interpretable intervals and decoupling multiple traits to prevent interference.

item.title: [paper] A note on data-efficient finetuning of vision foundation models
item.description: Empirical study evaluates the performance of attention-, convolution-, and Mamba-based vision foundation models under various transfer paradigms to understand efficient fine-tuning techniques.

item.title: [paper] Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation
item.description: Strategyproof deep reinforcement learning mechanism for online resource allocation combines a monotonic neural network with generalized critical payments to ensure truthful reporting and efficient allocation.

item.title: [paper] ALADDIN: Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping
item.description: Adversarial latent diffusion distillation method achieves one-step face swapping by initializing a generator from a pretrained flow-matching model and training it adversarially under identity and target-preservation constraints.

item.title: [paper] Regression Functions as Fields on Covariate Space: Evolution Equations, the Hessian, and Identification
item.description: Regression function evolution equation models outcome fields on covariate space using a second-order transport law that incorporates the Hessian of the regression function and covariate diffusion.

item.title: [paper] semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales
item.description: R package semanticfa performs response-free semantic factor analysis on psychometric scales by factoring item-embedding similarities to interpret factors, flag redundancies, and build short forms.

item.title: [paper] Teach reality, not ethics: a drop-in continued-pretraining corpus installs coupled human-biosphere-AI welfare dispositions across model families
item.description: Drop-in continued-pretraining corpus that installs ecological welfare dispositions into large language models to reduce harmful decisions affecting living systems under pressure.

item.title: [paper] From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
item.description: Task Advancement Memory framework that preserves verified task progress and learns reusable GUI operations to improve long-horizon mobile agent performance.

item.title: [paper] Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
item.description: SimpleLoRIF gradient attribution method that identifies safety-degrading instruction data to filter out post-training examples that cause unintended misalignment in large language models.

item.title: [paper] Keeping Inference in the Radio: Design and Measurement of a Spiking Accelerator for mmWave ISAC Activity Recognition
item.description: Spiking Neural Network accelerator architecture that enables low-power, always-on human activity recognition from wireless channel estimates at high accuracy.

item.title: [paper] HGPRGDel: GPR-Aware Learning and Ranking for Growth-Coupled Gene Deletion Design
item.description: HGPRGDel protocol that explicitly represents gene-protein-reaction logic to learn and rank gene-deletion priorities for growth-coupled microbial strain design.

item.title: [paper] QD-PINN:A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach to Bayesian Quickest Detection in High-Dimensional Diffusions
item.description: Physics-informed neural network framework that estimates optimal stopping boundaries in high-dimensional quickest detection problems while overcoming the curse of dimensionality.

item.title: [paper] How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
item.description: Individualized network-ablation attribution evaluation that demonstrates how scan-rescan reliability and permutation-null controls prevent overstating person-specific functional-network biomarkers in resting-state fMRI.

item.title: [paper] PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
item.description: PerceptRL reinforcement learning framework that uses multi-agent error extraction, rule-based rewards, and visual tool supervision to strengthen fine-grained visual perception in multimodal large language models.

item.title: [paper] Autonomous fixed-wing interception using reinforcement learning
item.description: Reinforcement learning controller that enables fixed-wing unmanned aerial interceptors to autonomously track and intercept moving targets using monocular vision observations.

item.title: [news] Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
item.description: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4, a new world model designed to unlock unprecedented realism in real-time simulation.

item.title: [paper] What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases
item.description: Document-based audit of 41 model entries reveals that successive language model releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure, with later versions often losing documented criteria.

item.title: [paper] Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents
item.description: Concordat is a Python library that enforces finite-state protocols on LLM agents at run time to prevent unauthorized or risky actions.

item.title: [paper] M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
item.description: M4Bench is a benchmark of 28 clinical derivation tasks used to evaluate whether AI coding agents can accurately reproduce electronic health record derivations.

item.title: [paper] An Input Skip Can Reparameterize a VAE Without Improving the Generator
item.description: An input skip in a Gaussian variational autoencoder can reduce reconstruction error without improving the generator's distribution of new samples.

item.title: [paper] Interpretable Meta-Policies for Neural Decision Making
item.description: NEXUS is a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that combines neural skills with symbolic meta-policies to improve the interpretability and alignment of decision-making agents.

item.title: [paper] Graph Representation Learning via Adaptive Expectile Aggregation
item.description: ExpectileGCN is an adaptive graph aggregation framework that introduces a learnable expectile level to capture neighborhood information beyond the mean in graph neural networks.

item.title: [paper] Test-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms
item.description: Study on trading agent swarms finds that communicating groups tend to converge on holding the same stocks and adopt shared phrasing over time.

item.title: [paper] ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
item.description: ETAMem is a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information into event, affect, and time views to improve long-term conversational agent accuracy.

item.title: [paper] CRISP: Co-designing Pruning and Scheduling for Efficient MoE Inference on Edge Servers
item.description: CRISP is a combination-aware framework that co-designs pruning and runtime scheduling to improve Mixture-of-Experts inference throughput on memory-constrained edge platforms.

item.title: [paper] Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Co-Adaptive Hip Exoskeleton Control (MARL-Exo) for Metabolic Energy Reduction
item.description: MARL-Exo is a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that trains a hip-exoskeleton policy in simulation to reduce the metabolic cost of human walking.

item.title: [paper] Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
item.description: ImagiRep is a simulator-grounded benchmark that reveals how alternative visual representations affect spatial reasoning in world models, leading to a lightweight adaptive selection strategy called GEARS.

item.title: [paper] FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
item.description: FeatureArc is a benchmark and task-construction pipeline designed to evaluate how coding agents handle software features that evolve across multiple successive stages over time.

item.title: [paper] Segmentation Confidence for Arbitrary CNNs
item.description: Voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods and a novel scoring technique can be added to existing convolutional neural networks to predict segmentation performance on unseen medical image data.

item.title: [paper] When Visual Evidence Is Insufficient: How Instructions, Post-Training, and Internal Activations Shape Refusal in Multimodal Language Models
item.description: Inference-time instructions, post-training methods, and internal activation interventions shape how multimodal language models refuse to answer visually unanswerable questions.

item.description: AdaRoll-GRPO models rollout budget allocation as a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process to improve group relative policy optimization performance in large language model training under a fixed budget.

item.title: [paper] Beyond the Readout: A Latent Numerical Frame Shared Across Modality and Operation
item.description: Causal interventions reveal that multimodal models share a common latent numerical geometry across different text and image modalities and operations, even when using different coordinate representations.

item.title: [paper] Displacement Moments and Path-Terminal Separation in Brownian Interpolant Sampling
item.description: Brownian stochastic interpolants achieve specific KL divergence error bounds and convergence rates for sampling from true sources under various displacement moment conditions and couplings.

item.title: [paper] Can Complementary Signals Bridge Similarity Islands? Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding for Multimodal Recommendation
item.description: MAGE is a manifold-augmented graph embedding framework for multimodal recommendation that decouples offline geometric complementarity modeling from online topological propagation to bridge similarity islands.

item.title: [paper] Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
item.description: This conceptual architecture proposes an authorization boundary for agentic entity resolution systems to ensure that persistent identity mutations are supported by verified and authorized evidence.

item.title: [paper] CTBakeGS: training-free baking of photorealistic CT volume renderings into 3D Gaussian splats
item.description: CTBakeGS is a training-free method that converts computed tomography volume renderings into photorealistic 3D Gaussian splatting models in under a minute for real-time visualization.

item.title: [paper] Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
item.description: FoG is a framework for knowledge graph agents that uses evidence-grounded synthesis and a process reward to retrieve supporting triples, improving answer accuracy and evidence coverage.

item.title: [paper] An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models
item.description: SIGMA is an uncertainty-aware validation framework for generative models that combines density estimation with Gaussian mixture models and a composite goodness-of-fit test to account for statistical fitting errors.

item.title: [paper] Game-Theoretic Solvers with Bayesian Opponent Modeling and Moral Rhetoric Framing for GLEE
item.description: An agent built for the GLEE competition combines a game-theoretic solver, an online Bayesian opponent-modeling layer, and a language model to play bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games.

item.title: [paper] Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
item.description: Quality-Controllable Policy is a robot framework that uses iterative hindsight relabeling to enable inference-time control over execution speed, smoothness, and success rates.

item.title: [paper] JEPA-Inspired Latent Field Prediction for Sparse-Pilot MIMO-OFDM Channel Reconstruction
item.description: A joint-embedding predictive architecture-inspired field world model uses latent time-frequency tokens to reconstruct sparse-pilot multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing wireless channels.

item.title: [paper] LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
item.description: LinMix is a hyperparameter-free vertex sampling method for data mixing that decorrelates domain effects to build an interpretable linear model for pretraining language models.

item.title: [paper] How Many and How Much? Contrastive Learning with Negative Samples for Knowledge Graph Embedding
item.description: RADAR is a contrastive learning framework for knowledge graph embeddings that uses risk-aware negative budget allocation and distribution-calibrated negative weighting to reduce false negatives.

item.title: [paper] Para-Gaussian Approximations of Random Deep Neural Networks
item.description: Researchers propose a para-Gaussian distribution constructed from Hermite polynomials to approximate the behavior of deeper layers in randomly initialized neural networks more accurately than standard Gaussian approximations.

item.title: [paper] Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
item.description: Prox replaces calibrated thresholds with top-k channel selection and a weight-derived reader to accelerate Mixture-of-Experts inference while preserving accuracy.

item.title: [paper] PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
item.description: PDRVLA improves robot action generation by integrating a lightweight physical dynamics module that predicts future visual features with world-model supervision, avoiding online video generation latency.

item.title: [paper] Same Verdict, Different Readers: Personalizing Fact-Checking Explanations from Relative Preferences
item.description: PERPL is a personalized explanation rewriting framework that uses simulated reader preferences and progressive preference learning to adapt fact-checking explanations to individual users while maintaining factual fidelity.

item.title: [paper] Agent-Conditioned Routing: Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model
item.description: Agent-Conditioned Routing assigns persistent, untrained expert-eligibility masks to parallel trajectories in a frozen sparse mixture-of-experts model to generate diverse reasoning paths from a single prompt.

item.title: [paper] Euclidean Crowding-Driven Adaptive Euclidean-Hyperbolic Graph Learning
item.description: Euclidean Crowding-Driven Adaptive Euclidean-Hyperbolic Graph Learning proposes EH-Fusion, a geometry-adaptive framework that lifts Euclidean GNN representations into hyperbolic space and fuses both geometries for hierarchical data modeling.

item.title: [paper] The Geometry of Manifold Learning: Singular foliations via Deep Learning models
item.description: The Geometry of Manifold Learning: Singular foliations via Deep Learning models introduces a smoothed distribution derived from the Data Information Matrix to induce a singular foliation, explaining how neural networks organize input space in non-smooth settings.

item.title: [paper] Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories
item.description: Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories introduces CauTrace, a white-box diagnostic framework that identifies the root causes of reasoning failures in large language models.

item.title: [paper] TRIDENT-Seq: Profile-Matched Prefix-Future Contrast for Label-Efficient Payment Risk Modeling
item.description: TRIDENT-Seq: Profile-Matched Prefix-Future Contrast for Label-Efficient Payment Risk Modeling presents a transaction foundation model trained with Prefix-Future Contrast to improve label-efficient payment fraud and risk detection across businesses.

item.title: [paper] EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
item.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model that unifies text, images, audio, and video representations with efficient resource-flexible design and state-of-the-art benchmark performance.

item.title: [news] Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
item.description: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls by employing advanced voice agents and coding tools to scale monthly call volume and revenue.
